name: bricksurance-data-core
title: Bricksurance Data Core
description: An open, business-first semantic data model for insurance, aligned to ACORD terminology with a crosswalk to the Lloyd's Core Data Record. Platform artifacts are generated from these specs; see bindings/ and tools/.
standards_basis: Aligned to ACORD terminology with an indicative Lloyd's Core Data Record crosswalk. The crosswalk is a hand-authored, best-knowledge mapping to ACORD / Lloyd's CDR element names, not a verified extract from the licensed models; element names are cited only, and the licensed standards are not reproduced.

domains.name: reference
domains.description: Shared code sets and classifications used across all domains, plus the generated data dictionary. Reference data is versioned with the model: allowed values live in the specs, not in anyone's head.

domains.name: org
domains.description: The group's own legal-entity structure - the reporting hierarchy every other domain hangs off. Solvency II, IFRS 17 and statutory accounts all report at solo (subsidiary) and group (consolidated) level; this domain is what makes that distinction real rather than assumed.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: The finance function proper - a real double-entry general ledger (chart of accounts, balanced journals, accounting periods), the operational sub-ledgers (premium, claims, commission, expense, receivables), regulatory and actuarial measures (Solvency II, IFRS 17), financial-statement structure, budget and FX. Everything a CFO org runs on.

domains.name: investment
domains.description: The asset side of the balance sheet - investment holdings, valuations and income. Roughly half an insurer's balance sheet; without it there is no balance sheet and no ALM conversation.

domains.name: party
domains.description: People and organisations, and the roles they play in the business (insured, broker, cedant, reinsurer, claimant). A party exists once; relationships are roles.

domains.name: policy
domains.description: Insurance contracts and their composition - policies, coverages, insured objects and premium transactions.

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Claims against policies and their financial development - reserves, payments and recoveries as transactions, never as overwritten balances.

domains.name: reinsurance
domains.description: Outward and inward reinsurance - treaties, cessions and recoveries linking the direct book to reinsurers.

domains.name: reserving
domains.description: Actuarial reserving as a governed semantic layer over claim transactions - loss-development triangles, chain-ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson estimates, IBNR and ultimate losses by accident year. Triangles are derived by summation over claim movements, never stored; the method used is a recorded, attestable choice. The spreadsheet workflow, done on the platform: reproducible, reconciling to source, and answerable in Genie.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Machine-readable products - offered coverages, underwriting questions and appetite rules as data, so any channel (human, aggregator or buyer agent) can discover, quote and be decided against the same rules.

domains.name: policy_lifecycle
domains.description: The append-only policy administration spine - every lifecycle event of a policy (quote, bind, endorse, renew, lapse, cancel) as an immutable, hash-chained record, and the slowly-changing versions derived from it. This is the shared key fabric that joins underwriting to claims to finance: current policy state is a projection of the event stream, never a hand-edited table, and a claim attaches to the policy version in force at the loss.

domains.name: enrichment
domains.description: External and derived risk data joined to the canonical model - telematics, credit, geospatial hazard, postcode, market benchmarks, demographics and sanctions screening. These are third-party or derived attributes about a policy, party or insured object, kept as governed, classified data rather than scattered feature tables. Pricing and underwriting both draw on them; modelling them once, with data classification, is what lets those workbenches share risk signal instead of each re-sourcing it.

domains.name: model
domains.description: Machine-learning and analytical models as governed assets - the model, its versions, the features it consumes, the scores it produces and its monitoring metrics. The layer represents AI the way it represents data: every score traces to a model version, every feature to a definition and a classification. This is what makes model governance a first-class part of the semantic layer, not a side system.

domains.name: pricing
domains.description: The rating structure - factors, their levels and relativities, engine configurations and the derived factor contributions on a quote or policy. Pricing decisions become explainable data: a quoted premium decomposes into the factors and relativities that produced it, and the engine config cites the model version behind it.

domains.name: renewal
domains.description: The renewal and retention loop - each policy's renewal cycle (invitation, price walk, competitor reference, outcome) and the observed retention response by segment and price-walk band. This is where the twin manages business in force rather than only writing it once, and the substrate for the closed loop that lets a pricing decision change next period's book.

domains.name: distribution
domains.description: How business reaches the insurer - channels and intermediary remuneration, transactional and disclosable.

domains.name: conduct
domains.description: Fair treatment made measurable - complaints per FCA groupings, through to ombudsman referral and redress.

domains.name: content
domains.description: Governed unstructured content - wordings, schedules, evidence, slips - with extracted text searchable under the same governance as rows.

domains.name: events
domains.description: The append-only business event stream - the near-real-time face of the model and the feed for monitoring agents.

domains.name: life
domains.description: Life business - grouped model points, governed assumption sets, economic scenario sets and valuation runs. Life policies themselves are ordinary policies with life lines of business.

domains.name: exchange
domains.description: Canonical data-exchange objects (bordereau lines, submissions) and the landing zone for inbound counterparty data before mapping to the canonical model.

domains.name: semantics
domains.description: Business metrics defined once over the canonical model - gross written premium, net earned premium, incurred, loss ratio, combined ratio. Physicalised as metric views where the platform supports them.

codes.label: Variable Fee Approach
codes.description: For contracts with direct participation features.

code_sets.name: mileage_band
code_sets.title: Mileage Band
code_sets.description: Annual mileage banding for a motor risk, derived from declared or telematics mileage. A rating exposure dimension.

codes.label: Low (<6k)
codes.description: Under 6,000 miles per year.

codes.label: Medium (6k-12k)
codes.description: 6,000 to 12,000 miles per year.

codes.label: High (12k-20k)
codes.description: 12,000 to 20,000 miles per year.

codes.label: Very High (>20k)
codes.description: Over 20,000 miles per year.

code_sets.name: model_purpose
code_sets.title: Model Purpose
code_sets.description: What a model is used for in the business - the decision or estimate it supports. Purpose is separate from type: a GBM might serve demand or fraud.

codes.label: Pricing - Frequency
codes.description: Predicts claim frequency for a risk.

codes.label: Pricing - Severity
codes.description: Predicts claim severity for a risk.

codes.label: Demand / Conversion
codes.description: Predicts conversion or price elasticity of demand.

codes.label: Fraud Propensity
codes.description: Scores a claim or application for fraud risk.

codes.label: Claims Triage
codes.description: Routes or prioritises a claim by predicted complexity.

codes.label: Narration / Reasoning
codes.description: Generates explanations or summaries with a language model.

codes.label: Reserving
codes.description: Estimates ultimate losses or IBNR.

code_sets.name: model_status
code_sets.title: Model Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a model version in production - the champion/challenger discipline that governs which version actually decides.

codes.label: Champion
codes.description: The version currently in force for decisions.

codes.label: Challenger
codes.description: A candidate version being evaluated against the champion.

codes.label: Shadow
codes.description: Scored in parallel for monitoring only; does not decide.

codes.label: Retired
codes.description: No longer in use; kept for lineage and reproducibility.

codes.label: Draft
codes.description: In development; not yet promoted to any serving role.

code_sets.name: model_subject_kind
code_sets.title: Model Subject Kind
code_sets.description: What kind of business object a model score is about. A score is polymorphic - it attaches to a policy, quote, claim or party - and this names which.

codes.label: Policy
codes.description: The score concerns a policy.

codes.label: Quote
codes.description: The score concerns a quote.

codes.label: Claim
codes.description: The score concerns a claim.

codes.label: Party
codes.description: The score concerns a party.

code_sets.name: model_type
code_sets.title: Model Type
code_sets.description: The kind of analytical or machine-learning model an asset is, independent of what it is used for.

codes.label: Generalised Linear Model
codes.description: Regression model, e.g. frequency or severity.

codes.label: Gradient Boosted Machine
codes.description: Tree-ensemble model, e.g. demand or fraud propensity.

codes.label: Large Language Model
codes.description: Foundation model used for narration, extraction or reasoning.

codes.label: Rules Engine
codes.description: Deterministic rule set, not a learned model.

codes.label: Statistical
codes.description: Other statistical estimator, e.g. a credibility or reserving model.

code_sets.name: monitor_metric_type
code_sets.title: Monitor Metric Type
code_sets.description: The kind of monitoring metric recorded for a model version over a period - performance and drift measures that govern whether it stays champion.

codes.label: AUC
codes.description: Area under the ROC curve; discrimination of a classifier.

codes.label: Gini
codes.description: Gini coefficient; rank-ordering power.

codes.label: Population Stability Index
codes.description: Shift in the scored population versus training.

codes.label: Feature Drift
codes.description: Distributional drift in input features.

codes.label: RMSE
codes.description: Root mean squared error of a regression model.

codes.label: Lift
codes.description: Lift of the top decile over the base rate.

code_sets.name: party_role_type
code_sets.title: Party Role Type
code_sets.description: The roles a party can play in the business. This code set is the model's number-one extension point: a new kind of counterparty is a new code here, not a new table.

standards.acord: Party role patterns of the ACORD Information Model

codes.label: Policyholder
codes.description: The party that entered into the policy contract and owes the premium.

codes.label: Insured
codes.description: A party whose interest is covered by the policy; often, but not always, the policyholder.

codes.label: Broker
codes.description: An intermediary placing the business on behalf of the policyholder.

codes.label: Claimant
codes.description: The party claiming under a policy; may be a third party.

codes.label: Cedant
codes.description: The insurer ceding risk under a reinsurance contract.

codes.label: Reinsurer
codes.description: The party assuming risk under a reinsurance contract.

codes.label: Coverholder
codes.description: A party authorised to bind business on the insurer's behalf under a delegated authority.

codes.label: Buyer Agent
codes.description: A machine agent requesting and negotiating cover on behalf of the buyer.

code_sets.name: party_type
code_sets.title: Party Type
code_sets.description: Fundamental legal nature of a party. Everything else about a party's place in the business is a role, never a type.

codes.label: Person
codes.description: A natural person.

codes.label: Organisation
codes.description: A legal entity - company, partnership, public body or association.

codes.label: Machine Agent
codes.description: An autonomous software agent acting on behalf of a person or organisation - a first-class counterparty with its own identity and audited decisions.

code_sets.name: period_status
code_sets.title: Accounting Period Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of an accounting period; postings are only allowed while OPEN.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Postings permitted.

codes.label: Closed
codes.description: Soft-closed; reopenable by finance with control.

codes.label: Locked
codes.description: Hard-locked after reporting; no further postings.

code_sets.name: policy_event_type
code_sets.title: Policy Event Type
code_sets.description: The kinds of lifecycle event a policy can undergo. Every workbench uses these codes - no local variants - so the policy administration spine reads the same everywhere.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: A quote was produced for the risk.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Cover was agreed and bound; the contract begins.

codes.label: Issued
codes.description: The policy document was issued to the insured.

codes.label: Endorsed
codes.description: A mid-term change was applied by endorsement.

codes.label: MTA Requested
codes.description: A mid-term adjustment was requested.

codes.label: MTA Applied
codes.description: A requested mid-term adjustment took effect.

codes.label: Renewal Invited
codes.description: A renewal invitation was issued ahead of expiry.

codes.label: Renewed
codes.description: The policy renewed into a successor term.

codes.label: Lapsed
codes.description: The policy lapsed at renewal (not renewed).

codes.label: Cancelled by Insured
codes.description: The insured cancelled the policy mid-term.

codes.label: Cancelled by Insurer
codes.description: The insurer cancelled the policy mid-term.

codes.label: Cancelled for Non-Payment
codes.description: Cancelled because premium was not paid.

codes.label: Reinstated
codes.description: A cancelled or lapsed policy was reinstated.

codes.label: Not Taken Up
codes.description: A bound policy was never taken up by the insured.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: The policy reached the end of its term without renewal.

code_sets.name: policy_status
code_sets.title: Policy Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a policy contract. Status reflects the contract as a whole; coverage-level suspension is modelled on the coverage entity.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: Terms offered to the prospective policyholder; no cover yet in force.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Cover agreed and legally binding but inception date not yet reached.

codes.label: In Force
codes.description: Cover currently active; today is within the cover period.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Cover period ended at its natural expiry date.

codes.label: Cancelled
codes.description: Cover terminated before natural expiry by either party; return premium may exist as premium transactions.

codes.label: Lapsed
codes.description: Cover terminated for non-payment of premium.

code_sets.name: premium_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Premium Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of premium movement. Premium is always modelled as signed transactions; balances such as gross written premium are derived by summation, never overwritten.

codes.label: Written Premium
codes.description: Premium written on binding or renewal of cover; positive amount.

codes.label: Adjustment Premium
codes.description: Mid-term or declaration-based premium adjustment; signed amount.

codes.label: Return Premium
codes.description: Premium returned to the policyholder, typically on cancellation; negative amount.

code_sets.name: product_status
code_sets.title: Product Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of an insurance product.

codes.label: Pilot
codes.description: Limited distribution while the proposition is proven.

codes.label: Active
codes.description: Open for new business.

codes.label: Closed to New Business
codes.description: In-force book continues; no new sales.

codes.label: Withdrawn
codes.description: Fully withdrawn.

code_sets.name: quote_status
code_sets.title: Quote Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a quotation. A quote that converts is linked to the resulting policy; premium only ever arises on the policy, never the quote.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Quotation requested and being worked.

codes.label: Offered
codes.description: Terms offered to the prospective policyholder.

codes.label: Converted
codes.description: Offer accepted; a policy has been issued from this quote.

codes.label: Declined by Insurer
codes.description: The insurer declined to offer terms.

codes.label: Rejected by Customer
codes.description: Terms offered but not taken up.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Offer lapsed unanswered at its validity date.

code_sets.name: rating_factor_kind
code_sets.title: Rating Factor Kind
code_sets.description: How a rating factor acts on premium - the arithmetic of the rating build-up, so a quoted premium can be decomposed and explained.

codes.label: Base Rate
codes.description: The starting base rate the factors act on.

codes.label: Multiplicative
codes.description: A relativity that multiplies the running premium.

codes.label: Additive
codes.description: A fixed amount added to the running premium.

codes.label: Discount
codes.description: A multiplicative relativity below 1 that reduces premium.

codes.label: Loading
codes.description: A multiplicative relativity above 1 that increases premium.

code_sets.name: receivable_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Receivable Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Premium billing movements. Outstanding debt is the signed sum - invoices positive, cash negative - never a stored balance.

codes.label: Invoice
codes.description: Premium invoiced to the payer; positive.

codes.label: Cash Receipt
codes.description: Premium cash received; negative.

codes.label: Write-off
codes.description: Irrecoverable balance written off; negative.

codes.label: Refund
codes.description: Premium refunded to the payer; positive.

code_sets.name: recovery_type
code_sets.title: Recovery Type
code_sets.description: Sources of recovery on a claim - how money comes back after a payment. The dimensional detail behind RECOVERY claim transactions.

codes.label: Subrogation
codes.description: Recovery pursued against a liable third party.

codes.label: Salvage
codes.description: Proceeds from disposal of damaged property.

codes.label: Contribution
codes.description: Recovery from another insurer covering the same loss.

codes.label: Reinsurance
codes.description: Recovery under a reinsurance treaty.

codes.label: Deductible
codes.description: Recovery of the policy excess from the insured.

code_sets.name: referral_action
code_sets.title: Referral Action
code_sets.description: What a referral rule does when its condition is met - the action taken on a risk that trips the rule.

codes.label: Refer
codes.description: Route to a human underwriter for a decision.

codes.label: Decline
codes.description: Decline the risk automatically.

codes.label: Load
codes.description: Apply a premium loading.

codes.label: Restrict
codes.description: Offer only on restricted terms.

codes.label: Notify
codes.description: Allow but flag for monitoring.

code_sets.name: referral_outcome
code_sets.title: Referral Outcome
code_sets.description: How a fired referral was resolved - what the underwriter decided after the rule routed the risk to them.

codes.label: Pending
codes.description: Awaiting an underwriter decision.

codes.label: Accepted
codes.description: Underwriter accepted the risk, possibly on amended terms.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Underwriter declined the risk.

codes.label: Overridden
codes.description: Underwriter overrode the rule's suggested action.

codes.label: Auto-Resolved
codes.description: Resolved automatically without human intervention.

code_sets.name: renewal_outcome
code_sets.title: Renewal Outcome
code_sets.description: How a renewal cycle resolved - renewed, or lapsed with the reason. Separating price-driven lapse from other lapse is what makes retention analysis and the renewal loop meaningful.

codes.label: Renewed
codes.description: The policy renewed into a successor term.

codes.label: Lapsed (price)
codes.description: Not renewed; the customer left over price.

codes.label: Lapsed (other)
codes.description: Not renewed for a non-price reason.

codes.label: Pending
codes.description: Renewal invited; outcome not yet known.

code_sets.name: reporting_level
code_sets.title: Reporting Level
code_sets.description: Whether a figure is a single entity's own return (solo) or the consolidated group position. Solvency II and statutory accounts both require both.

codes.label: Solo
codes.description: A single legal entity's own reporting.

codes.label: Group
codes.description: Consolidated across the group, after eliminations.

code_sets.name: reporting_regime
code_sets.title: Reporting Regime
code_sets.description: The reporting framework a figure is prepared under. One valuation or statement figure means different things under different regimes; the regime is never assumed.

codes.label: Solvency II
codes.description: EIOPA Solvency II prudential regime.

codes.label: IFRS 17
codes.description: IFRS 17 insurance contracts accounting standard.

codes.label: Statutory / Local GAAP
codes.description: Local statutory accounting basis.

codes.label: Management
codes.description: Internal management-reporting basis.

code_sets.name: reserve_category
code_sets.title: Reserve Category
code_sets.description: The split of a case reserve by kind of cost - so indemnity, expense and legal reserves are visible separately, as claims and reserving teams hold them.

codes.label: Indemnity
codes.description: Reserve for the loss payment itself.

codes.label: Expense
codes.description: Reserve for allocated loss adjustment expense.

codes.label: Legal
codes.description: Reserve for legal and defence costs.

codes.label: Recovery
codes.description: Anticipated recovery held as a negative reserve.

code_sets.name: reserving_method
code_sets.title: Reserving Method
code_sets.description: Actuarial methods for projecting ultimate losses from a development triangle. The method is a governed, attestable choice: swapping it produces a new reserve estimate row, never an overwrite, so bases are comparable and the sign-off records which method set the reserves.

codes.label: Chain-Ladder
codes.description: Volume-weighted age-to-age development factors applied to the latest diagonal; the standard deterministic method for mature, stable lines.

codes.label: Bornhuetter-Ferguson
codes.description: Blends the chain-ladder projection with an a-priori expected loss ratio, weighting toward the prior for immature accident years.

codes.label: Expected Loss Ratio
codes.description: Ultimate set from an a-priori loss ratio times earned premium, ignoring emerged experience; used for the greenest accident years.

codes.label: Cape Cod
codes.description: A Bornhuetter-Ferguson variant that derives the expected loss ratio from the triangle itself rather than taking it as given.

code_sets.name: run_verdict
code_sets.title: Run Verdict
code_sets.description: Quality-gate verdict of a processing or valuation run. RED runs never feed downstream consumption; the verdict is part of the auditable run record.

codes.label: Green
codes.description: All quality checks passed; results released downstream.

codes.label: Amber
codes.description: Passed with warnings; released with commentary.

codes.label: Red
codes.description: Quality gate failed; results blocked from downstream use.

code_sets.name: sanctions_list
code_sets.title: Sanctions List
code_sets.description: Which screening list a sanctions or PEP hit was raised against. A hit is an indicator for review, never an automatic decision.

codes.label: OFSI Consolidated
codes.description: UK financial sanctions consolidated list.

codes.label: EU Consolidated
codes.description: EU consolidated financial sanctions list.

codes.label: OFAC SDN
codes.description: US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list.

codes.label: UN Consolidated
codes.description: United Nations Security Council consolidated list.

codes.label: PEP
codes.description: Politically Exposed Persons watchlist.

code_sets.name: scenario_status
code_sets.title: Scenario Set Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of an economic scenario set. Exactly one set is ACTIVE for production valuations; others remain AVAILABLE for analysis.

codes.label: Active
codes.description: The scenario set used by production valuation runs.

codes.label: Available
codes.description: Delivered and validated, usable for analysis, not the production set.

codes.label: Superseded
codes.description: Replaced by a newer set; retained for reproducibility.

code_sets.name: source_system
code_sets.title: Source System
code_sets.description: Systems of record that feed the data layer. Provenance is part of the model: every core entity carries a source_system_code, and identifiers are only unique within their source system.

codes.label: Policy Administration (Core)
codes.description: The group's core policy administration system.

codes.label: Claims (Core)
codes.description: The group's core claims management system.

codes.label: Reinsurance (Core)
codes.description: The group's reinsurance administration system.

codes.label: Data Core (Mastered)
codes.description: Records mastered or derived inside the data layer itself, such as deduplicated golden party records.

codes.label: Life Administration (Core)
codes.description: The group's life policy administration and valuation feed.

codes.label: Coverholder Bordereau
codes.description: Lines reported by coverholders or brokers via bordereaux and mapped into the canonical model through the exchange domain.

code_sets.name: statement_type
code_sets.title: Financial Statement Type
code_sets.description: The primary financial statement a line belongs to.

codes.label: Balance Sheet
codes.description: Statement of financial position.

codes.label: Income Statement
codes.description: Statement of profit or loss.

codes.label: Cash Flow Statement
codes.description: Statement of cash flows.

code_sets.name: submission_status
code_sets.title: Submission Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of a reinsurance submission from receipt to bind or decline.

codes.label: Received
codes.description: Submission received and awaiting triage.

codes.label: In Review
codes.description: Under triage, pricing and accumulation assessment.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: Terms quoted back to the cedant or broker.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Accepted and bound; a treaty exists for this submission.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Declined by the reinsurer.

codes.label: Withdrawn
codes.description: Withdrawn by the cedant or broker before a decision.

code_sets.name: subsidence_band
code_sets.title: Subsidence Band
code_sets.description: Ground-stability / subsidence risk banding for a location, from modelled geology and claims history.

codes.label: Low
codes.description: Stable ground; negligible subsidence exposure.

codes.label: Moderate
codes.description: Some clay-shrinkage or historic movement exposure.

codes.label: High
codes.description: Material subsidence exposure requiring rating loading.

code_sets.name: tax_type
code_sets.title: Tax Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of tax the group accounts for.

codes.label: Insurance Premium Tax
codes.description: Premium tax collected on policies and remitted to the authority.

codes.label: Corporation Tax
codes.description: Tax on taxable profits.

codes.label: Deferred Tax
codes.description: Deferred tax on timing differences.

code_sets.name: treaty_type
code_sets.title: Treaty Type
code_sets.description: Forms of treaty reinsurance. Direction (assumed or ceded) is determined by the cedant and reinsurer party roles on the treaty, not by this code.

codes.label: Quota Share
codes.description: Proportional treaty ceding a fixed share of every risk in scope.

codes.label: Surplus
codes.description: Proportional treaty ceding the portion of each risk above the cedant's retained line.

codes.label: Excess of Loss (Per Risk)
codes.description: Non-proportional cover for individual risk losses above an attachment point.

codes.label: Excess of Loss (Catastrophe)
codes.description: Non-proportional cover for accumulated losses from a single catastrophe event.

code_sets.name: underwriting_decision_type
code_sets.title: Underwriting Decision
code_sets.description: Outcome of an underwriting decision. Every decision records who or what decided and against which appetite rule - human and machine decisions are audited identically.

codes.label: Accept
codes.description: Risk accepted at the quoted terms.

codes.label: Refer
codes.description: Referred to a human underwriter; outside automatic authority.

codes.label: Decline
codes.description: Risk declined.

code_sets.name: urbanity
code_sets.title: Urbanity
code_sets.description: Settlement type of a postcode, urban to rural, used as a rating and accumulation dimension.

codes.label: Major Urban
codes.description: Major conurbation or city centre.

codes.label: Urban
codes.description: Town or suburban area.

codes.label: Suburban
codes.description: Suburban / commuter belt.

codes.label: Rural
codes.description: Village or open countryside.

code_sets.name: uw_submission_status
code_sets.title: Underwriting Submission Status
code_sets.description: Status of a direct underwriting submission as it moves from received to a quote or a decline - the grain before a quote exists.

codes.label: Received
codes.description: Submission received; not yet triaged.

codes.label: In Appetite
codes.description: Passed appetite screening; proceeding to rate.

codes.label: Referred
codes.description: Routed to a referral for a human decision.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: A quote was produced from the submission.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Declined; no quote offered.

codes.label: Withdrawn
codes.description: Withdrawn by the broker or prospect.

code_sets.name: valuation_measure
code_sets.title: Valuation Measure
code_sets.description: Financial measures produced by valuation processes across regimes. One code set serves life and non-life, Solvency II and IFRS 17: a measure is a defined quantity, and new regimes add codes, not tables.

standards.lloyds_cdr: n/a — regime measures per Solvency II / IFRS 17 definitions

codes.label: Best Estimate Liability
codes.description: Present value of expected future cash flows, Solvency II best estimate.

codes.label: Risk Margin
codes.description: Solvency II risk margin over the best estimate.

codes.label: Technical Provision
codes.description: Best estimate plus risk margin.

codes.label: Case Reserves (Total)
codes.description: Sum of open case reserves at the valuation date.

codes.label: IBNR
codes.description: Incurred-but-not-reported reserve at the valuation date.

codes.label: Solvency Capital Requirement
codes.description: Solvency II capital requirement.

codes.label: Own Funds
codes.description: Eligible own funds at the valuation date.

codes.label: Contractual Service Margin
codes.description: IFRS 17 contractual service margin.

codes.label: Risk Adjustment
codes.description: IFRS 17 risk adjustment for non-financial risk.

codes.label: Minimum Capital Requirement
codes.description: Solvency II minimum capital requirement.

codes.label: Eligible Own Funds - Tier 1
codes.description: Tier 1 eligible own funds under Solvency II.

codes.label: SCR Coverage Ratio
codes.description: Eligible own funds over SCR, expressed as a ratio.

codes.label: Liability for Remaining Coverage
codes.description: IFRS 17 liability for remaining coverage.

codes.label: Liability for Incurred Claims
codes.description: IFRS 17 liability for incurred claims.

codes.label: Deferred Acquisition Costs
codes.description: Acquisition costs deferred and amortised over the cover period.

codes.label: Unearned Premium Reserve
codes.description: Premium received but not yet earned.

entities.name: claim
entities.title: Claim
entities.description: A demand for indemnity under a policy arising from a loss event. The claim record holds the event and handling state; all financial development lives in claim transactions.
entities.grain: One row per claim per source system.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Stable, source-agnostic identifier for the claim, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the claim is made under.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Coverage the claim attaches to, where the source provides it.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number as issued by the claims system. Unique within a source system - always interpret together with source_system_code.

attributes.name: claim_status_code
attributes.description: Current handling status of the claim.

attributes.name: cause_of_loss_code
attributes.description: Primary peril or event that gave rise to the claim.

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date the loss occurred.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date the loss was first reported to the insurer. Must be on or after loss_date.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the loss circumstances.

attributes.name: handling_office
attributes.description: Claims office or team handling the file.

attributes.name: catastrophe_id
attributes.description: Catastrophe event the claim is attributed to, where it belongs to one.

attributes.name: reopened_flag
attributes.description: Whether the claim has been reopened after closure.

attributes.name: policy_version_id
attributes.description: The policy version in force at the loss date - claims attach to the as-at version, not just the policy, so cover is read as it stood at loss.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the claim originates from.

quality.name: reported_after_loss
quality.description: A loss cannot be reported before it happens.

entities.name: claim_feature
entities.title: Claim Feature
entities.description: A feature (head of damage) within a claim - a sub-claim that reserves and settles on its own, e.g. own damage versus third-party injury under one motor claim. Financial development still flows through claim transactions; the feature gives claims and reserving teams the grain they actually work at.
entities.grain: One row per feature per claim.

attributes.name: claim_feature_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the claim feature.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The claim this feature belongs to.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Coverage the feature attaches to, where the source provides it.

attributes.name: claim_feature_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of feature (head of damage).

attributes.name: claim_status_code
attributes.description: Handling status of the feature; features can close independently.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Claims system the feature originates from.

entities.name: claim_party_role
entities.title: Claim Party Role
entities.description: A party and the role it plays on a specific claim - handler, adjuster, claimant, third party, solicitor or supplier. Distinct from policy-level party roles: it captures who is involved in this loss, not the contract.
entities.grain: One row per party per role per claim.

attributes.name: claim_party_role_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the claim party role.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The claim the party is involved in.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: The party playing the role.

attributes.name: claim_party_role_type_code
attributes.description: The role the party plays on the claim.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System the involvement originates from.

entities.name: claim_recovery
entities.title: Claim Recovery
entities.description: A recovery pursued or received on a claim, with its source - subrogation, salvage, contribution, reinsurance or deductible. The dimensional detail behind RECOVERY claim transactions: what kind of recovery, against whom, and where it stands.
entities.grain: One row per recovery per claim.

attributes.name: claim_recovery_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the recovery.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The claim the recovery relates to.

attributes.name: recovery_type_code
attributes.description: Source of the recovery.

attributes.name: against_party_id
attributes.description: Party the recovery is pursued against, where applicable.

attributes.name: expected_amount
attributes.description: Recovery anticipated, in the claim currency.

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Recovery actually received to date, in the claim currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the recovery amounts.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the recovery, e.g. open, received, closed.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Claims system the recovery originates from.

entities.name: claim_reserve_category
entities.title: Claim Reserve Category
entities.description: The split of a claim feature's case reserve by category - indemnity, expense, legal - as at a date. A reporting decomposition of the reserve; the movements themselves remain claim transactions, and the categories sum to the feature's outstanding reserve.
entities.grain: One row per feature per reserve category per as-at date.

attributes.name: claim_reserve_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the reserve category row.

attributes.name: claim_feature_id
attributes.description: The claim feature the reserve category belongs to.

attributes.name: reserve_category_code
attributes.description: The category of reserve.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Reserve held in this category, in the claim currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the reserve amount.

attributes.name: as_at_date
attributes.description: Date the reserve split was struck.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Claims system the split originates from.

entities.name: claim_transaction
entities.title: Claim Transaction
entities.description: A signed financial movement on a claim: case reserve movements, indemnity and expense payments, and recoveries. Outstanding, paid and incurred are always derived by summation over these movements, never stored as balances.
entities.grain: One row per financial movement per claim.

standards.acord: Claim payment / reserve patterns of the ACORD Information Model

attributes.name: claim_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the claim transaction.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Claim the movement belongs to.

attributes.name: claim_transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of financial movement.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the transaction currency. Reserve increases positive, reserve releases negative; payments positive; recoveries negative from the insurer's cost perspective.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date the movement was booked.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the movement originates from.

entities.name: fraud_signal
entities.title: Fraud Signal
entities.description: A fraud indicator raised on a claim, with its score and provenance. Signals inform SIU referral decisions; a signal is never itself a decision.
entities.grain: One row per signal per claim.

attributes.name: fraud_signal_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the signal.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Claim the signal concerns.

attributes.name: fraud_signal_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of indicator.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Signal strength 0-100.

attributes.name: detected_at
attributes.description: When the signal was raised.

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: What was observed, in business language.

attributes.name: model_version_id
attributes.description: Model version that raised the signal, where a model did; ties the business-facing signal to the governed model and its score.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Detecting system.

entities.name: litigation
entities.title: Litigation
entities.description: Legal proceedings arising from a claim - status, jurisdiction and the legal reserve. Litigation is a material driver of claim cost and duration; modelling it lets the claims workbench track defended matters distinctly.
entities.grain: One row per suit per claim.

attributes.name: litigation_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the litigation matter.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: The claim the proceedings arise from.

attributes.name: litigation_status_code
attributes.description: Status of the proceedings.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Court or jurisdiction the matter is in.

attributes.name: legal_reserve
attributes.description: Reserve held for legal and defence costs, in the claim currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the legal reserve.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date proceedings were first notified.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System the litigation record originates from.

entities.name: complaint
entities.title: Complaint
entities.description: A customer complaint, categorised per UK FCA reporting groupings and tracked through to ombudsman referral. The conduct domain is where fair treatment becomes measurable.
entities.grain: One row per complaint per source system.

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the complaint.

attributes.name: complaint_reference
attributes.description: Reference as issued to the complainant.

attributes.name: complainant_party_id
attributes.description: The complaining party.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy concerned, where applicable.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Claim concerned, where applicable.

attributes.name: complaint_category_code
attributes.description: Root category.

attributes.name: complaint_status_code
attributes.description: Handling status.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date received.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date resolved or referred; empty while open.

attributes.name: redress_amount
attributes.description: Redress paid, where upheld, in the stated currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of any redress.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record.

quality.name: closed_after_received
quality.description: A complaint cannot close before it is received.

entities.name: document
entities.title: Document
entities.description: Governed unstructured content: policy wordings, schedules, claim evidence, survey reports, MRC slips. The extracted text is carried in the row so LLM tools search and cite documents under the same classification and lineage as structured data; binary originals live in a Volume referenced by path.
entities.grain: One row per document version.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the document.

attributes.name: document_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of document.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Document title.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Product context (wordings attach here).

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy context (schedules attach here).

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Claim context (evidence attaches here).

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Submission context (slips attach here).

attributes.name: extracted_text
attributes.description: Full extracted text, indexed for semantic search.

attributes.name: volume_path
attributes.description: Path to the binary original in a governed Volume, where one exists.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date the document version was created.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record.

quality.name: exactly_one_context
quality.rule: exactly one of product_id, policy_id, claim_id, submission_id is not null
quality.description: A document belongs to exactly one business context.

entities.name: commission_transaction
entities.title: Commission Transaction
entities.description: A signed intermediary remuneration movement on a policy. Transactional like all money in this model; disclosable commission is a query, not a project.
entities.grain: One row per commission movement per policy per intermediary.

attributes.name: commission_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the movement.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: The policy the commission relates to.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: The intermediary earning (or repaying) the commission.

attributes.name: commission_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of remuneration.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: Commission rate applied, as a fraction of premium.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the transaction currency; clawbacks negative.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date the movement was booked.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record.

entities.name: credit_bureau_summary
entities.title: Credit Bureau Summary
entities.description: A banded summary of a party's consumer credit standing from a bureau pull. Banded, not raw, and held only where a lawful basis and disclosure exist. Personal data - classified accordingly.
entities.grain: One row per party per bureau pull.

attributes.name: credit_bureau_summary_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the bureau summary record.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Party the bureau summary concerns.

attributes.name: pull_date
attributes.description: Date the bureau summary was obtained.

attributes.name: credit_score_band_code
attributes.description: Banded credit rating from the bureau.

attributes.name: ccj_count
attributes.description: Count of county court judgments on file.

attributes.name: electoral_roll_flag
attributes.description: Whether the party is present on the electoral roll at the address.

attributes.name: consent_id
attributes.description: Consent record providing the lawful basis for the bureau pull.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Bureau or aggregator the summary originates from.

entities.name: geospatial_hazard
entities.title: Geospatial Hazard
entities.description: Modelled peril hazard for a location - flood, subsidence, crime and coastal exposure - with the source it came from. Used in property rating and catastrophe accumulation. A modelled classification, not a live event state.
entities.grain: One row per location key per hazard source.

attributes.name: geospatial_hazard_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the hazard record.

attributes.name: location_key
attributes.description: Location the hazard describes - postcode, grid reference or gazetteer id. Insured objects carry the same key to join hazard.

attributes.name: postcode
attributes.description: Postcode the location falls in, where resolvable.

attributes.name: flood_band_code
attributes.description: Modelled flood risk banding.

attributes.name: subsidence_band_code
attributes.description: Modelled ground-stability risk banding.

attributes.name: crime_index
attributes.description: Relative crime index for the area, 0-100.

attributes.name: coastal_flag
attributes.description: Whether the location is within a coastal exposure zone.

attributes.name: hazard_source_code
attributes.description: Provenance of the hazard classification.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System the hazard record was loaded through.

entities.name: market_pricing_benchmark
entities.title: Market Pricing Benchmark
entities.description: External market premium benchmarks by line of business, segment and period - where the insurer's price sits against the market. Feeds demand modelling and competitive-position views. Commercially sensitive.
entities.grain: One row per line of business per segment per period.

attributes.name: market_pricing_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the benchmark record.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business the benchmark covers.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Market segment or tier the benchmark applies to.

attributes.name: benchmark_period
attributes.description: Period the benchmark represents, e.g. 2026-Q2.

attributes.name: market_median_premium
attributes.description: Median market premium for the segment, in the benchmark currency.

attributes.name: rank_percentile
attributes.description: Where the insurer's average price ranks, 0 (cheapest) to 100.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the benchmark premium.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Market-intelligence provider the benchmark originates from.

entities.name: motor_telematics_aggregate
entities.title: Motor Telematics Aggregate
entities.description: Aggregated driving behaviour for a motor policy over a period, from a telematics device or app. Aggregates only - never raw journey traces - so the rating signal is usable without holding location-level personal data.
entities.grain: One row per policy per observation period.

attributes.name: telematics_aggregate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the telematics aggregate record.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Motor policy the behaviour was observed for.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start of the observation window.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End of the observation window.

attributes.name: observed_miles
attributes.description: Miles observed in the window.

attributes.name: mileage_band_code
attributes.description: Annualised mileage banding derived from observed miles.

attributes.name: harsh_braking_rate
attributes.description: Harsh-braking events per 100 miles.

attributes.name: night_driving_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of miles driven between 11pm and 5am.

attributes.name: telematics_score
attributes.description: Composite driving score 0-100; higher is safer.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Telematics provider or platform the aggregate originates from.

quality.name: period_ordered
quality.description: The observation window must end on or after it starts.

entities.name: policy_demographics
entities.title: Policy Demographics
entities.description: Banded demographic and prior-history attributes for a policy's proposer, used as rating dimensions. Banded, never raw, and personal - classified accordingly. Held only where a lawful basis and disclosure exist.
entities.grain: One row per policy.

attributes.name: policy_demographics_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the demographics record.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the demographic attributes describe.

attributes.name: age_band
attributes.description: Banded proposer age, e.g. 30-39.

attributes.name: tenure_band
attributes.description: Banded length of relationship with the insurer.

attributes.name: prior_claims_band
attributes.description: Banded count of prior claims in the last five years.

attributes.name: occupation_class
attributes.description: Occupation class grouping used in rating.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System the demographic attributes were sourced from.

entities.name: postcode_enrichment
entities.title: Postcode Enrichment
entities.description: Area attributes for a postcode - settlement type, deprivation and region - used as rating and accumulation dimensions. Reference-like: keyed by postcode, shared across policies and objects in that area.
entities.grain: One row per postcode.

attributes.name: postcode
attributes.description: Postcode or postal-area key the attributes describe.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Country the postcode belongs to.

attributes.name: urbanity_code
attributes.description: Settlement type of the postcode.

attributes.name: deprivation_decile
attributes.description: Index of multiple deprivation decile, 1 (most) to 10 (least).

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Statistical region the postcode sits in.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Provider the postcode attributes originate from.

entities.name: sanctions_screen
entities.title: Sanctions Screen
entities.description: The result of screening a party against sanctions and PEP lists. A hit is an indicator that routes the party to review; it is never an automatic decline. Personal data - classified accordingly.
entities.grain: One row per party per screening run.

attributes.name: sanctions_screen_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the screening record.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Party that was screened.

attributes.name: screen_date
attributes.description: Date the screening was run.

attributes.name: hit_flag
attributes.description: Whether the screen raised a potential match.

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Whether the match was a politically-exposed-person indicator.

attributes.name: sanctions_list_code
attributes.description: List the match was raised against, where there was a hit.

attributes.name: cleared_flag
attributes.description: Whether review cleared the hit as a false positive.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Screening provider the result originates from.

entities.name: business_event
entities.title: Business Event
entities.description: The event stream: business moments (quote requested, loss notified, payment made, complaint received) as append-only, timestamped records referencing the entity they concern. This is the near-real-time face of the model and the natural feed for monitoring agents.
entities.grain: One row per business event occurrence; append-only.

attributes.name: business_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the event.

attributes.name: business_event_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of event.

attributes.name: subject_entity
attributes.description: Entity name of the subject (e.g. quote, claim).

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the subject row.

attributes.name: occurred_at
attributes.description: When the event occurred.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Channel the event arrived through, where relevant.

attributes.name: payload
attributes.description: Event payload as JSON, schema per event type.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Emitting system.

entities.name: premium_bordereau_line
entities.title: Premium Bordereau Line (inbound)
entities.description: The canonical form of an inbound premium bordereau line, as reported by a coverholder or broker. Messy source files land in the exchange domain and are mapped into this shape - using the data dictionary as the contract - before flowing into the core model.
entities.grain: One row per policy per reporting month per inbound bordereau.

attributes.name: bordereau_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the bordereau line, assigned on ingestion.

attributes.name: reporting_month
attributes.description: First day of the calendar month the bordereau reports on.

attributes.name: coverholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the coverholder or broker submitting the bordereau.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Policy reference as reported by the coverholder; matched to the core model downstream.

attributes.name: insured_name
attributes.description: Name of the insured as reported.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business, mapped from the coverholder's own class descriptions to the canonical code set.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Cover inception as reported.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Cover expiry as reported.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the reported amounts.

attributes.name: gross_premium
attributes.description: Gross written premium reported for the line.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Coverholder commission reported for the line.

attributes.name: risk_country_code
attributes.description: Country of the risk location, where reported.

attributes.name: risk_postcode
attributes.description: Postal code of the risk location, where reported.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Provenance of the line; coverholder bordereaux use COVERHOLDER_BDX.

entities.name: accounting_period
entities.title: Accounting Period
entities.description: A financial reporting period for a legal entity, with its open/closed/locked status. Postings are only permitted into open periods; the close process moves periods to locked. The unit the finance calendar runs on.
entities.grain: One row per period per legal entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the period.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The entity whose books this period governs.

attributes.name: period_label
attributes.description: Human label, e.g. 2026-Q2.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First day of the period.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the period.

attributes.name: period_status_code
attributes.description: Open, closed or locked.

entities.name: chart_of_account
entities.title: Chart of Account
entities.description: The chart of accounts: every ledger account with its type (which fixes its normal balance) and its parent, forming the account hierarchy that statements roll up. This is what turns classified postings into a real general ledger.
entities.grain: One row per ledger account.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the account.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Ledger account number.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Account name.

attributes.name: account_type_code
attributes.description: Asset, liability, equity, income or expense - fixes the normal balance.

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Parent account for roll-up; empty at the top of the hierarchy.

attributes.name: statement_type_code
attributes.description: Which primary statement the account belongs to.

entities.name: contract_group
entities.title: Contract Group (IFRS 17)
entities.description: An IFRS 17 group of contracts - the unit of account for the standard: contracts of similar risk, managed together, issued within a year, split by onerous status. Carries the measurement model and links to the entity and line. The CSM roll-forward and the LRC/LIC split hang off this.
entities.grain: One row per group of contracts.

attributes.name: contract_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the group of contracts.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The carrier holding the group.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business of the group.

attributes.name: cohort_year
attributes.description: Annual cohort (issue year) - contracts more than a year apart cannot share a group.

attributes.name: measurement_model_code
attributes.description: IFRS 17 model applied (GMM, PAA, VFA).

attributes.name: onerous
attributes.description: Whether the group is onerous at initial recognition.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the group's measurement.

entities.name: csm_movement
entities.title: CSM Movement (IFRS 17)
entities.description: A step in the contractual service margin roll-forward for a group of contracts in a period: opening, new business, interest accretion, experience adjustments and release to profit. The closing CSM is the signed sum over the opening - a balance derived from movements, never overwritten, and produced by an auditable valuation run.
entities.grain: One row per movement type per contract group per period.

attributes.name: csm_movement_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the movement.

attributes.name: contract_group_id
attributes.description: The group of contracts.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: The run that produced this movement - the audit anchor.

attributes.name: csm_movement_type_code
attributes.description: Which step of the roll-forward this is.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the group currency; release is negative.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

entities.name: expense_transaction
entities.title: Expense Transaction
entities.description: An operating expense allocated to a line of business - the missing half of the combined ratio, transactional like all money in the model.
entities.grain: One row per expense allocation per line per period booking.

attributes.name: expense_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the expense movement.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The entity the expense is booked in.

attributes.name: expense_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of expense.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line the expense is allocated to.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the stated currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Booking date.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record.

entities.name: financial_plan
entities.title: Financial Plan
entities.description: A budgeted or forecast figure for a legal entity, line and measure in a period - the plan side of budget-versus-actual. FP&A cannot function without it; pairing it with the actuals metric views is the variance story.
entities.grain: One row per plan version per entity per line per measure per period.

attributes.name: financial_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the plan figure.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The entity the plan is for.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Plan version, e.g. 2026 Budget v1.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business, where the plan is at line level.

attributes.name: plan_measure
attributes.description: What is planned, e.g. gross_written_premium or combined_ratio.

attributes.name: period_label
attributes.description: Period the figure applies to, e.g. 2026-Q3.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Planned value in the stated currency (or a ratio, per plan_measure).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency, for monetary plan measures.

entities.name: fx_rate
entities.title: FX Rate
entities.description: A foreign-exchange rate to the group presentation currency at a date - what makes group consolidation across multi-currency subsidiaries a real number instead of a per-currency caveat.
entities.grain: One row per from-currency per rate date.

attributes.name: fx_rate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the rate.

attributes.name: from_currency_code
attributes.description: Currency being translated.

attributes.name: to_currency_code
attributes.description: Presentation currency translated to.

attributes.name: rate_date
attributes.description: Date the rate applies.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: Units of to-currency per one unit of from-currency.

entities.name: journal
entities.title: Journal
entities.description: A journal entry header: a balanced set of debit and credit lines posted to one legal entity in one period. Every journal's lines sum to zero - that invariant is what makes this a real double-entry ledger rather than a pile of classified amounts.
entities.grain: One row per journal entry.

attributes.name: journal_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the journal.

attributes.name: journal_reference
attributes.description: Human reference for the journal.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The entity whose ledger this posts to.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: The period the journal posts into; must be open at posting time.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Ledger date of the entry.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: What the entry records.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System that raised the journal.

quality.name: journal_balances
quality.description: Debits and credits within a journal must net to zero.

entities.name: journal_line
entities.title: Journal Line
entities.description: A single debit or credit line of a journal, posted to one ledger account and carrying a signed amount (debits positive, credits negative) plus its source operational transaction. Trial balance and financial statements are sums over these lines; the link to source rows makes the ledger reconcile to the sub-ledgers by construction.
entities.grain: One row per posting line.

attributes.name: journal_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the line.

attributes.name: journal_id
attributes.description: The journal this line belongs to.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: The ledger account posted to.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the entity's functional currency: debits positive, credits negative. Lines within a journal sum to zero.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: source_entity
attributes.description: Entity name of the originating operational row (e.g. premium_transaction).

attributes.name: source_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational row, for reconciliation.

entities.name: receivable_transaction
entities.title: Receivable Transaction
entities.description: Premium billing and collection movements on a policy. Written premium is earned exposure; this is the cash reality - outstanding and aged debt are signed sums over these rows.
entities.grain: One row per billing movement per policy.

attributes.name: receivable_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the movement.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy billed.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The entity carrying the receivable.

attributes.name: receivable_transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of movement; invoices positive, receipts negative.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the stated currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Booking date.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Payment due date, for invoices - the anchor for ageing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record.

entities.name: statement_line
entities.title: Statement Line
entities.description: The mapping from ledger accounts to financial-statement line items - how the chart of accounts becomes a balance sheet, income statement and cash flow. Different regimes present differently, so a line carries its regime; this is what lets the same ledger produce a Solvency II balance sheet and an IFRS/statutory one.
entities.grain: One row per statement line item per account per regime.

attributes.name: statement_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the mapping row.

attributes.name: statement_type_code
attributes.description: Which primary statement the line belongs to.

attributes.name: reporting_regime_code
attributes.description: Presentation regime this mapping is for.

attributes.name: line_label
attributes.description: The statement line item, e.g. 'Net earned premium' or 'Total assets'.

attributes.name: line_order
attributes.description: Presentation order within the statement.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: The ledger account that rolls up into this line.

attributes.name: sign
attributes.description: +1 or -1 applied to the account balance for presentation.

entities.name: tax_transaction
entities.title: Tax Transaction
entities.description: A tax movement for a legal entity - insurance premium tax, corporation tax, deferred tax. IPT in particular is a real line on every premium; this makes the tax position queryable rather than buried.
entities.grain: One row per tax movement per entity.

attributes.name: tax_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the movement.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: The entity the tax relates to.

attributes.name: tax_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of tax.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Source policy, for premium tax.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the stated currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Booking date.

attributes.name: source_system_code

entities.name: valuation_result

attributes.name: valuation_result_id

attributes.name: currency_code

entities.name: investment_holding
entities.title: Investment Holding
entities.description: An investment asset held by a legal entity - the asset side of the balance sheet. Book cost and market value are carried here; income and revaluations are transactional. Without this domain there is no balance sheet and no asset-liability conversation.

attributes.name: investment_holding_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id

attributes.name: asset_class_code

attributes.name: instrument_name

attributes.name: isin
attributes.description: ISIN where the instrument is a listed security.

attributes.name: book_cost
attributes.description: Acquisition cost in the entity's functional currency.

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: Current market value in the entity's functional currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amounts.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date the market value was struck.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record (typically an investment/custody system).

entities.name: investment_transaction
entities.title: Investment Transaction
entities.description: A movement on an investment holding - purchase, sale, coupon, dividend or fair-value revaluation. Investment income and gains (the P&L line) and the movement in asset values (the balance sheet) are both derived from these.
entities.grain: One row per investment movement.

attributes.name: investment_transaction_id

attributes.name: investment_holding_id

attributes.name: investment_transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of movement.

attributes.name: amount

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: transaction_date

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record.

entities.name: assumption_set
entities.title: Assumption Set
entities.description: A versioned, governed set of actuarial assumptions (mortality, lapse, expense, economic). Sets move through a maker/checker lifecycle; valuation runs record exactly which approved set they used, which is what makes any past result reproducible.
entities.grain: One row per assumption set version per assumption type.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the assumption set version.

attributes.name: assumption_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of assumption governed by this set.

attributes.name: assumption_status_code

attributes.name: version

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: What changed in this version and why.

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_at

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the assumption set originates from.

entities.name: model_point
entities.title: Model Point
entities.description: A grouped model point for life valuation: policies compressed into cohorts (attained age by outstanding term) at a valuation date. Model points are derived from in-force life policies; the grouping is proven back to the policy count and sum assured it represents.

attributes.name: model_point_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the model point.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Valuation date the model point file was cut at.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Life line of business the cohort belongs to.

attributes.name: age_attained

attributes.name: outstanding_term_years

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: Number of in-force policies grouped into this model point.

attributes.name: sum_assured
attributes.description: Total sum assured of the cohort, in the cohort currency.

attributes.name: annual_premium

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: source_system_code

entities.name: scenario_set
entities.title: Scenario Set
entities.description: A delivered economic scenario set (risk-free curves, equity paths) used by stochastic valuation. Registered with a lifecycle so exactly one set is active for production runs, and every run records which set it used.
entities.grain: One row per delivered scenario set.

attributes.name: scenario_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the scenario set.

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: scenario_status_code
attributes.description: Lifecycle status; exactly one set is ACTIVE for production.

attributes.name: scenario_count
attributes.description: Number of stochastic paths in the set.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Market date the set was calibrated to.

attributes.name: source_system_code

entities.name: valuation_run
entities.title: Valuation Run
entities.description: One execution of a valuation process: which valuation date, which approved assumption sets (one per assumption type, via valuation_run_assumption), which scenario set, which model version, run by whom, with what quality verdict. attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the run.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id

attributes.name: reporting_level_code
attributes.description: Solo (this entity) or group (consolidated).

attributes.name: reporting_regime_code
attributes.description: Regime the run is prepared under (Solvency II, IFRS 17...).

attributes.name: valuation_date

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: When the run executed.

attributes.name: scenario_set_id
attributes.description: Scenario set the run used, for stochastic runs.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version of the valuation model/engine used (e.g. a Unity Catalog model version).

attributes.name: run_verdict_code

attributes.name: run_by

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System that executed the run.

entities.name: valuation_run_assumption
entities.title: Valuation Run Assumption
entities.description: Which assumption sets a valuation run used - one row per assumption set, typically one per assumption type (mortality, lapse, expense, economic). This junction is what makes any past result exactly reproducible: run plus sets plus scenario plus model version is the full recipe.
entities.grain: One row per assumption set used by a valuation run.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: The valuation run.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: An assumption set the run used.

entities.name: feature_definition
entities.title: Feature Definition
entities.description: A single model feature defined once - what it means, where it comes from and how it is classified. Features are governed the same way attributes are: a feature built from personal data carries that classification wherever it is used.
entities.grain: One row per feature.

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the feature.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Feature name as referenced by models.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: What the feature represents, in business language.

attributes.name: source_entity

attributes.name: expression
attributes.description: Definition or derivation of the feature, as documentation.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Data classification inherited by the feature - internal, confidential or pii.

attributes.name: pii_flag
attributes.description: Whether the feature is built from personal data.

entities.name: feature_set
entities.title: Feature Set
entities.description: A named collection of features a model version consumes. The set is the contract between features and models; membership is resolved through feature_set_member so the same feature can serve many sets.
entities.grain: One row per feature set.

attributes.description: Identifier for the feature set.

attributes.name: name
